indicators.note: something spoilt has been ruined or messed up, so these letters are reworked into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone lucky even at a moment when things were ruined.
explanation.definitionFit: Something providential arriving at just the right moment, as if a gift from above, is a stroke of luck.

indicators.note: one thing stuffing another is packed inside it, so mum goes inside the chicken

parts.note: a chicken is a hen
mum is mother, MA

explanation.surface: Mother prepares a stuffed chicken for a hungry hero.
explanation.walkthrough: The kitchen picture hides a container clue: 'stuffs' is the insertion signal, not cookery.
explanation.definitionFit: Hercules, the mythical strongman, is the archetype of a macho muscular male.

indicators.note: the helping is placed after the party, following it in the answer

parts.note: a do is a party or celebration
a helping is a portion, a ration

explanation.surface: Affection that comes from serving food once the party is over.
explanation.definitionFit: Adoration is deep, worshipful affection, a strong form of love.

clue.text: Boredom to an extent rotten nuisance

indicators.note: to an extent says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Tedium is, in some measure, a dreadful pest.
explanation.definitionFit: Ennui is a French borrowing for listless weariness and dissatisfaction, the same as tedium.

clue.text: Drinker very troublesome to start with

parts.note: so can mean very, as in 'so good'

indicators.note: to start with picks the opening letter of the word troublesome; any backwards run of letters across these words is a coincidence

explanation.surface: A boozer who is a real nuisance from the outset.
explanation.definitionFit: A sot is a habitual drunkard, one who drinks heavily.

indicators.note: unusually signals the letters of ultra set out in an unusual order

explanation.surface: The Latin phrase for the ultimate, ironically called boring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ne plus ultra' (the highest point) is a ready-made phrase; here 'plus' just joins NE to UTRAL, the rearrangement 'unusually' makes of ULTRA.
explanation.definitionFit: A neutral colour is a muted, drab shade such as grey or beige, so it is dull.

clue.text: Scoundrel, British, to go without protection

parts.note: to lack something is to go without it
a guard is a form of protection

explanation.surface: A British rogue left unprotected.
explanation.definitionFit: A blackguard is an old word for a villain or rogue, someone dishonourable.

indicators.note: a vehicle carrying a passenger holds it inside, so bishop goes inside car

parts.note: a limo is a limousine, a car
B is the chess notation for bishop

explanation.surface: A limousine ferrying a churchman to somewhere uncertain.
explanation.definitionFit: Limbo is an uncertain intermediate condition, a state of waiting with no clear outcome.

clue.text: Run to corrupt politician making bid

indicators.note: to corrupt something is to spoil or alter it, so the letters of run to are rearranged

parts.note: MP, Member of Parliament, is a politician

explanation.surface: A politician runs in order to be bribed while bidding for something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to corrupt' rearranges RUN TO into NOTRU. 'bid' is a call in the card game bridge.
explanation.definitionFit: In bridge, a call naming no trump suit is one of the possible bids at auction.

clue.text: Becoming number one in France — this requires capital

parts.note: becoming means fitting or seemly, proper
un is French for one

explanation.surface: A French title of respect that needs money to back it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks financial but means a capital letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Names of particular people and places are written with an initial capital letter by grammatical rule.

clue.text: It can go on spreading disease

indicators.note: spreading out the letters of it can go on scatters them into a new order

explanation.surface: A spreading illness just keeps on going.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spreading' rearranges IT CAN GO ON; the whole clue also reads as a description of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Contagion is a communicable infection passed from person to person.

indicators.note: altered says the letters of sunshine are changed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: The weather changed, so the temperature drove people indoors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'altered' rearranges SUNSHINE into NISSENHU. A Nissen hut is a half-cylinder corrugated-iron building used by the British military.
explanation.definitionFit: This prefabricated semicircular corrugated-iron building served as wartime housing or storage.

indicators.note: curtailed means cut short, losing the tail end of the word for unrest

parts.note: a riot is a violent public disturbance, unrest

explanation.surface: Civil disturbances were cut short in an urban area.
explanation.definitionFit: Rio de Janeiro is a major Brazilian city, commonly shortened in speech.

clue.text: Doctor taking walk round reveals stratagem

indicators.note: round says the walk is wrapped around the doctor

parts.note: a gait is a manner of walking
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a medical doctor's degree

explanation.surface: A physician on his rounds uncovers a clever plan.
explanation.definitionFit: A gambit is an opening move, originally in chess, made to gain an advantage: a tactic.

clue.text: Carriage cutting horse in two — that's ghastly

indicators.note: a thing cutting another goes into it, so the carriage goes inside the horse
in two says the horse is split into two parts by what cuts it

parts.note: a mare is a female horse
a cab is a horse-drawn carriage

explanation.surface: A grisly scene: a carriage slicing a horse in half.
explanation.definitionFit: Macabre means gruesome, dwelling on death and horror.

parts.note: lives means exists, is
elderly means old

explanation.surface: A princess resides with an aged continental.
explanation.definitionFit: Isolde is the Irish princess of the Tristan legend and Wagner's opera.

clue.text: Answer given by Roman Catholic in Bow

explanation.surface: A Catholic in Bow, a district of East London, gives a reply.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bow' reads as the London place name but is a curve.
explanation.definitionFit: A bow is a curved shape, like a rainbow, so it is a curve.

indicators.note: pants is British slang for rubbish or poor, so the letters of wearing no are made a mess of

explanation.surface: A Nordic person going without underwear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pants' looks like underwear but is slang for rubbish, signalling a rearrangement of WEARING NO.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Norway is a Scandinavian, Norway being one of the Nordic countries.

indicators.note: overthrows means the pieces are turned over, read backwards in this down clue

parts.note: an is the indefinite article, A
a tsar is a Russian emperor

explanation.surface: A Jamaican sect member topples a monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Rastafarianism is a religious movement founded in Jamaica, and its followers are called by this short name.

indicators.note: beginning to go says the first letter of the word for victor is dropped

parts.note: a victor is a winner

explanation.surface: The champion starts to blush.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Victor' is not the NATO letter V but a winner.
explanation.definitionFit: In archery the ring next to the bullseye on a target is coloured red.

parts.note: to dub is to name or call
IOUs are written promises to pay, promissory notes

explanation.surface: Calling in debts on doubtful IOUs.
explanation.definitionFit: Dubious means doubtful or suspect, open to question.

clue.text: United were victorious according to report

indicators.note: according to report means as heard spoken, a sound-alike

parts.note: were victorious means won

explanation.surface: Reports say Manchester United won the match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'United' looks like the football club but means joined as a single unit.
explanation.definitionFit: People united are at one, in a single whole.

indicators.note: from says the letters are taken out of the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A worshipper from Nazareth is held in a dungeon.
explanation.definitionFit: A Hindu is an adherent of Hinduism, a religious faith.

clue.text: Supporter has complaint about new player

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the complaint goes around new

parts.note: a beef is slang for a complaint or grievance
a player on stage is an actor

explanation.surface: A patron grumbles about a newcomer to the cast.
explanation.definitionFit: A benefactor gives money or help to a cause, so is a backer.
